settings.title: Over Ten Years of R&D
settings.content:
Working on the cutting edge of biophysics, we've taken the best of both worlds and created a red light therapy sauna like no other. We are on a different wavelength, literally.

Imagine a sauna that does more than just make you sweat. The FireLight® Spectrum is where optimized light and infrared heat therapy unite to transform your health from the inside out. We've taken the best of nature and refined it into a simple, effective, and incredibly soothing experience that fits seamlessly into your life.

settings.title: The Truth About Red Light
settings.content: Red LEDs barely scratch the surface. Most saunas just get hot. FireLight® is something else entirely: a revolutionary red & near infrared spectrum designed to restore you from within. Watch how we built the light your body’s been missing.

settings.title: The Sauna Redefined
settings.content: You’ll sweat like crazy, and love every second of it. No steam. No suffocating heat. Just deep, full-spectrum infrared warmth that feels like sunbathing. No preheat, no wasted time. This is heat therapy, evolved.

settings.title: The Deepest Healing Experience Under the Sun
settings.content: Most red light panels and far infrared saunas barely penetrate beyond the surface, absorbed by skin or water before they can reach deeper tissues. FireLight® is different. Its near-infrared wavelengths deliver both light and heat therapy deep into the body, reaching muscle and even organ-level tissue for unmatched healing depth.

settings.title: Light Years Ahead
settings.content: There are a lot of red light therapy devices out there. But they are not created equal.
settings.column_1: In order to understand the power of our Firelight Spectrum®, let's dive into the science of light therapy, otherwise known as photobiomodulation.
settings.column_2:
Infrared light, just beyond the visible spectrum, is the warmth you feel from the sun. Our bodies are uniquely receptive to red and near-infrared light, which penetrate deeply to energize your cells, reduce inflammation, and boost circulation. It's like harnessing a piece of the sun in every session.

With our Firelight Spectrum®, we take the best of the sun's spectrum, and eliminate the harmful UV and blue light.

settings.title: More Comfortable and Effective
settings.content: Now that we've talked about light therapy, let's talk about heat. Traditional saunas take forever to heat up. And they feel stifling because they heat the air, not your body. Our FireLight® Spectrum warms you from the inside out, just like the gentle glow of a bonfire. This deep, radiant infrared heat raises your core temperature by three degrees, triggering your body's natural detox and repair processes at the cellular level, all while providing a soothing, invigorating experience without the uncomfortable, stifling heat.

settings.title: Can I get a sunburn or tan with FireLight®?
settings.content: No. Our full-spectrum infrared technology doesn’t include any ultraviolet (UV) light. UV causes a chemical burn in the skin tissue that leads to sunburn. Also, UV causes the skin to produce the melanin pigment that gives the skin a tan look.

settings.title: How does the FireLight® bulb emit both light and heat therapy at the same time?
settings.content:
Our FireLight® is red and near-infrared light therapy combined with heating infraed. This means deep, rich core heating and mitochondrial stimulation at natural levels of irradiance from a single source.  

FireLight® is full-spectrum infrared experience. The full light emission range is between 550-3000+ nm with no UV. These are all the wavelengths studied for red light therapy (photobiomodulation, 600-1000 nm). Our uniquely deep, efficient and soothing heat comes primarily from about half of the near infrared range 980 - 1500 nm. This is the part of near-infrared that provides radiant heat by being absorbed by our body's water molecules. Our bulb also emits mid-infrared (MIR) 1500 - 3000 nm and far-infrared (FIR) 3000+ nm, which also support the heating process, although MIR and FIR do not penetrate our tissues deeply like near-infrared.

settings.title: What is the difference between near and far infrared therapy?
settings.content:
Near infrared (NIR) light is in the part of the electromagnetic spectrum that provides light  and heat therapy at the same time. 

Light therapy, also called red light therapy or photomodulation, comes from red light and near infrared light in the range 600-1000 nm. Photons in this light range are absorbed by our mitochondria’s special light receptors and activate many healing and regenerative processes in the cells. Light therapy is essentially a process of photons being converted to elections which activate our biology in an amazing way. 

Heat therapy, also called hyperthermia, is when your cells are heated up somehow and your cells respond with production of heat shock proteins and other heat-induced cellular responses. If we use deeply penetrating near infrared light (980 – 1500 nm) as the heat source, this is called radiant heating, wherein the heat is produced immediately 4-5 inches inside your body because the near infrared light photons go that deep and are absorbed by water in the deep tissues. The near infrared light penetrates deeply to help you heat up and sweat faster.  In contrast, if you are in a hot tub or a traditional sauna, the water or air surrounding your body heats you slowly from the outside inward, in a conductive heating process. 

Far infrared (FIR) light only provides heat therapy, but it is 100% absorbed by the water. And since your body is volumetrically composed of over 99% water, almost all far-infrared photons are absorbed by the water in your skin. This means that FIR saunas effectively function as conductive hyperthermia, and which is a much slower way of heating your body than our FireLight®’s radiant approach.

settings.title: Is this the same as red light therapy?
settings.content:
Yes. Red light therapy is just one part of the SaunaSpace spectrum. Red light and near infrared light in the range 600-1000 nm stimulate special healing and regenerative cellular processes. So both red light and near infrared in this range deliver light therapy benefits.

The big difference between red and near infrared is that red light is also absorbed by melanin in your skin and hemoglobin in your blood, so red doesn't get into the deep tissues. Red light primarily stimulates the skin tissue.

Near infrared, however, goes into our body much deeper, around 4-5 inches! So near infrared delivers light therapy to our brain, internal organs and all the deep tissues that red light cannot access.

Our FireLight® includes red light and near-infrared light (plus mid-infrared and far-infrared which support the heat therapy). As you can see in the FireLight® Spectrum above on this page, we've designed our light to really focus on near-infrared, because only near-infrared can stimulate light therapy benefits in both the shallow and the deep tissue.

Also, the benefits of our FireLight® technology extend far beyond the capabilities of red light therapy alone, because you also get powerful heat therapy.
